verdict.rationale: cubic is an agentic AI code reviewer, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it, but the evidence pack never shows users plugging their own MCP servers into cubic. cubic's documented MCP role is server-side only: it exposes its own MCP server to external coding agents. Its first-party integrations (Jira, Linear, Notion, Confluence, Datadog) are adjacent features, not user-pluggable MCP tools, so none of this earns credit here.
